mapper.update: UPDATE inventory_compensation_task SET task_status = 'SUCCEEDED', update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, last_error = NULL WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND task_type = #{taskType} AND task_status != 'SUCCEEDED'
mapper.select: SELECT id, order_id, route_id, task_type, task_status, retry_count, next_retry_time, last_error, create_time, update_time FROM inventory_compensation_task WHERE task_status = 'PENDING' AND next_retry_time <= #{now} ORDER BY next_retry_time, id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE inventory_compensation_task SET task_status = 'PROCESSING', update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND task_status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE inventory_compensation_task SET task_status = 'SUCCEEDED', update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, last_error = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND task_status = 'PROCESSING'

UPDATE inventory_compensation_task SET retry_count = retry_count + 1, task_status = CASE WHEN retry_count + 1 >= #{maxRetries} THEN 'NEEDS_RECONCILE' ELSE 'PENDING' END, next_retry_time = #{nextRetryTime}, last_error = #{lastError}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND task_status = 'PROCESSING'
UPDATE inventory_compensation_task SET task_status = 'PENDING', update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE task_status = 'PROCESSING' AND update_time <= #{staleBefore}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inventory_compensation_task WHERE route_id = #{routeId} AND task_status IN ('PENDING', 'PROCESSING') AND task_type != 'ROUTE_RECONCILE'
mapper.update: UPDATE inventory_compensation_task SET task_status = 'PENDING', retry_count = 0, next_retry_time = #{nextRetryTime}, last_error = NULL, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE order_id = #{routeId} AND task_type = 'ROUTE_RECONCILE'
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT route_id FROM inventory_compensation_task WHERE task_status = 'NEEDS_RECONCILE' ORDER BY route_id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE inventory_compensation_task SET task_status = 'SUCCEEDED', update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, last_error = NULL WHERE route_id = #{routeId} AND task_status = 'NEEDS_RECONCILE'
